name: Adrenaline Rush
text: Below 50% Health: 20% faster and +1 Stamina per second, but 30% less damage.

name: Angler
text: Mudcrabs and slaughterfish turn friendly; better catches; fishing rods hit twice as hard and can summon a mudcrab. 10% weaker to shock.

name: Au Naturel
text: +100 Health, Magicka and Stamina, minus 40 each per worn piece. +1 each per level per empty slot.

name: Autodidact
text: Learn every spell of a school at 25/50/75/100. Spells cost 30% more; magic vendors charge 35% more.

name: Bad Natured
text: +20% damage while crouched and better pickpocketing. −20% damage standing; Divines amulets hurt you.

name: Bane of the Wicked
text: +20% damage to undead, daedra and werewolves; −10% to everything else.

name: Bulwark
text: Standing still: +200 armor and reflect 10% physical damage. Extra Stamina drain while running and sprinting.

name: Defiler
text: +20% damage to playable races; −10% to everything else.

name: Disbeliever
text: Dwemer armor and weapons 40% stronger. No blessings.

name: Disciplined
text: Bows and crossbows +20% damage; draw and reload 40% slower.

name: Dovah Tinvaak
text: Shout 20% more often at 30% less effect.

name: Druid
text: Spriggans friendly, druidic spells +30%, craft Lifebloom Essence. 25% weaker to fire and axes.

name: Elemental Conduit
text: Fire, shock and frost spells rise and fall with the weather.

name: Fast Shot
text: Bows draw and crossbows reload 40% faster; 30% less damage.

name: Focused
text: Below 50% Health: +5 Magicka per second and absorb 10% of spells, but take 10% more damage.

name: Gambler
text: +30% critical chance, −40% weapon damage; each critical stacks +10% damage for 30 seconds.

name: Giantkin
text: +10% magic resistance and blunt damage. Cannot read skill books or use scrolls and staves.

name: Glutton
text: Food 25% stronger; potions half as effective.

name: Lurker
text: Naked: sneak attacks ×2.5, sneak 25% better, immune to disease. Armor gives nothing, cooked food does nothing, weapons over weight 10 deal no damage.

name: Good Natured
text: −20% weapon and Destruction damage. With a Divines amulet: beneficial magic +20% and 20% less damage taken.

name: Hoarder
text: +200 carry weight; selling prices 50% worse.

name: Introvert
text: +15% damage against three or fewer enemies; −10% against four or more.

name: Jack of All Spells
text: Novice to Adept spells 20% stronger; Expert and Master 20% weaker.

name: King of Worms
text: +1 summon or thrall; summons and raised dead last 33% shorter.

name: Light Foot
text: Barefoot: muffled steps, 10% faster, no fall damage. In boots: 10% slower.

name: Marathon Runner
text: Sprinting restores 5 Stamina and 1 Health per second; no Stamina regeneration while running or standing.

name: Master of Destiny
text: No birthsign. +5 perk points and +5 to every skill.

name: Master of One
text: One skill set to 100 with all its perks. No perk points from levels.

name: Nosferatu
text: −50 Speech, no regeneration outdoors. Skeever meat grants speed and fast regeneration.

name: Old Fashioned
text: Iron, steel, wood, leather, hide, fur, scaled and Forsworn gear 15% stronger; everything else 10% weaker.

name: Pacifist
text: Hands lowered: +2 Magicka and Stamina per second. Hands raised in combat: the reverse.

name: Rage
text: Below 50% Health: +10% damage and 10% less damage taken, but 30% slower.

name: Skilled
text: Skill books give +1 extra and trainers cost half. No perk point every 5th level.

name: Soul Reaver
text: Enchantments 15% stronger and cheaper to run; armor and weapon damage −20%.

name: Swimmer
text: Swim faster, breathe underwater, regenerate when wet. 50% less regeneration on dry land.

name: Unbound Hands
text: No gloves: spells +15%, unarmed +30. Wearing gloves: the reverse.

name: Way of the Voice
text: Hostile shouts 30% weaker; non-hostile shouts have a 20% chance to reset their cooldown.

name: Witcher
text: Potions and ingredients 25% stronger and longer. Only four potion effects at a time.

name: Addict
text: Skooma and alcohol last twice as long; craft skooma at a cooking pot. Sober: 25% chance to stagger when hit.

name: Phalanx
text: Spears, javelins, pikes and halberds +15% damage; take 50% more from behind. Unique pike.

name: Wizard's Wardrobe
text: Wands 30% stronger with a wizard hat; without one, all spells 10% weaker.

name: Touch of the Arcane
text: Touch and cloak spells +20%; other spells 10% weaker.

name: Silent Dovah
text: +5 Health, Magicka and Stamina per unspent dragon soul (not as a werewolf or vampire). Persuade and intimidate almost never work.

name: Serene Presence
text: Persuasion almost always works, pacify spells +20%. Intimidation half as likely, frenzy spells 20% weaker.

name: Dominating Will
text: Intimidation almost always works, frenzy spells +20%. Persuasion harder, pacify spells 20% weaker.

name: Fatal Attraction
text: Pick a gender: +20% physical damage to it, 20% more damage taken from the other.

name: Blighted Fists
text: Unarmed +10 disease damage per disease you carry, diseases affect you half as much. Disease resistance −200%.

name: Acoustic Arcanist
text: Sonic spells +20% after playing an instrument at an inn. Followers cost more; physical attacks 15% weaker.

name: Unshakable
text: Shield bashes +50% damage and 20% cheaper; 20% slower when not blocking.

name: Focused Precision
text: Arrows and bolts 15% weaker but 20% chance to push targets back, scaling with Marksman.

name: Soul Embed
text: Spend a dragon soul: shouts 50% stronger for an hour.

name: Blood Warrior
text: +50 Health and +5 Health per level. Take 50% more physical damage; 100% weakness to poison.

name: Sunkissed
text: Sun spells +15%. 25% weaker to frost, 50% at night.

name: Monk
text: Quarterstaff power attacks disarm while you wear no armor. Unique battlestaff.

name: Shehai
text: Bound weapons +15% damage; 25% more damage from undead.

name: Balanced Casting
text: Pick a resistance: yours and every enemy within 200 feet drop by 25%.

name: Plagued Mind
text: Undead summons last 200% longer; your Magicka is 0 while a summon is up.

name: Self-Taught
text: −100 Magicka at start; +1 Magicka per 5 books or notes read (max +300).

name: Focused Magic
text: One school 25% stronger and 10% costlier; the other four 50% weaker.

name: Focused Combat
text: One of One-Handed, Two-Handed or Marksman: +10% damage, 10% less taken. The other two: the reverse.

name: Iron Knees
text: Arrows and bolts do 50% less and restore 20 Stamina on hit; 15% slower.

name: Quester
text: −50 Health, Magicka and Stamina at start; +2 each per quest completed (max +200).

name: The True Apprentice
text: Spells cost 60% less but are 40% weaker.

name: Big Swing
text: Power attacks +20%; light attacks 25% weaker.

name: Fencer
text: Light attacks +30%; power attacks 25% weaker.

name: Blood Mage
text: Blood and absorb spells +20%; Health reduced by 2 × your level.

name: Wanderer
text: −50 Stamina and −50% Stamina regeneration at start; +1 Stamina and +1% regeneration per 2 locations found (max +200).

name: Drunken Mage
text: No Magicka regeneration while sober. Drinking: +100% Stamina and Magicka regeneration and a stronger next spell.
